name: showreel-26-longname

voice.text: Why does one long name break your card? The name has an ellipsis, but it still pushes the button off. A flex item won't shrink below its content. The fix: min width zero, on the flex item. Now it shrinks, and the long name ends in dots.

caption:
Why does one long name break your card? 💳

Your name has overflow: hidden, white-space: nowrap and text-overflow: ellipsis, yet it still pushes the button out of the card. The name sits in a flex item, and a flex item's min-width is auto: its smallest allowed width is its content, here the whole one-line name. Add min-width: 0 to that flex item (the wrapper, not the text): it can shrink, and the ellipsis finally shows. Works in every browser (Chrome 21+, Firefox 34+, Safari 7+ have the auto minimum). overflow: hidden on the flex item does the same.
Save it for your next list or contact card, or send it to whoever builds your app.
keywords: text-overflow ellipsis not working in flexbox

sources.note: MDN min-width, auto: for flex items the minimum width is the specified suggested size, else the min-content size; 0 only if the flex item is a scroll container
MDN text-overflow: only shows on a box with overflow other than visible and white-space: nowrap
min-width: auto: Chrome 21, Firefox 34 (16-21 used auto as initial value, removed in 22), Safari 7

tip.title: Why does one long name break your card?
tip.why: The name has text-overflow: ellipsis, but it sits inside a flex item whose min-width is auto. MDN: for a flex item that minimum is its min-content size, so with white-space: nowrap the item can never be narrower than the whole name, and it pushes the button out of the card. min-width: 0 on the flex item lets it shrink, and the ellipsis shows. Every current browser.
